title: Queen Slayer
description:
After a cataclysmic event devastated the surface world, survivors had no choice but to flee underground. The subterranean realm is a labyrinthine space where remnants of past cities and nature intertwine, filled with mysterious energies and lurking dangers. Each zone is ruled by a formidable queen, and peace remains a distant dream unless they are defeated.

You are the leader of an expedition determined to reclaim hope in this bleak world. Your mission is to defeat the eight queen monsters and find the key to rebuilding the shattered world. Explore each queen's domain, discover powerful weapons and artifacts, and engage in fierce battles alongside your companions. In this world where danger and mystery coexist, your courage and strategy will determine the fate of all.

Adventure awaits. Uncover the secrets of the underground world, vanquish the queens, and restore hope to the world!

- Start a battle with 4 heroes and monsters of the underworld.

- Start your journey to defeat the boss.
- Take risks, aim for greater rewards or choose a safer route.

- New Characteristics
- Acquire new attributes and grow heroes on your journey.Game Features
'Queen Slayer' is a turn-based RPG set in a fascinating fantasy world. The player must lead heroes of various professions and skills to defeat the powerful queens who dominate the underground dungeons and save the kingdom from darkness.

Party-Based Turn-Based Combat
Recruit up to four heroes and maximize skill synergies to overcome your foes.

Roguelite Elements
Each journey resets your heroes' traits, except for their unique characteristics. Take risks to earn greater rewards. Heroes who die are lost forever, but new heroes can join your team through rescue missions.
description_short: A tightly focused, streamlined turn-based roguelike RPG you can finish in 2–3 hours. Challenge the short but razor-sharp journey to slay 8 corrupted queens.
